A lot of fats are ignorant enough of CICO, TDEE, and the calories in the food and drink that they consume that the weight sort of creeps up on them. Once they realize they're fat, they fail to make effective changes and then give up and blame anything but themselves.

The food most readily available to people is probably less healthy and pushed in larger portions than it historically was. Our occupations, on average, are also a lot more sedentary. Conversely, we haven't evolved physiologically since we were hunter-gatherers. We have to make conscious decisions to control our eating, often overriding biological mechanisms -- evolved when starvation was a day-to-day concern and creating fat stores a rare luxury -- which encourage overeating. The environment is perfect for becoming fat.

Those of us who resist getting fat have to make decisions to lead active lifestyles and/or make healthy meals. While some of us just naturally fell into it through our interests or upbringing, many others have had to re-educate themselves after looking in the mirror one day and deciding they didn't like the trend they were seeing. Fat people don't get to this point. Instead, they get caught up by

  1. Ignorance of nutrition/exercise
  2. Failure to stick to a plan
  3. Disordered eating

All of these things are negative, and if we think negative things about ourselves, it creates psychological dissonance. Basically, a contradiction between those thoughts and our innate desires be the "good guy" in the narratives of our own lives. The people who are eventually successful take responsibility, clear up their ignorance, get a trainer, nutritionist, or therapist, and create and stick to a plan or series of plans to get healthy. The hopeless fats just flip the table at this point and head into:

  1. Denial of responsibility
  2. Delusions about diet/exercise/health or personal beauty/attractiveness

And a lot of the time, they're surrounded by an insulating bubble of other fats who feed this denial and crabbily undermine their friends' efforts to get healthy. Body Positive crabs build up their delusions of personal beauty by twisting not hating yourself into being proud of a shitty body. HAES crabs build up their denial of health by pointing to fat powerlifters, "perfect" blood work, low-grade pseudoscientific studies, and Ragenesque fat internet folk heroes whose exploits, if less epic than those of Pecos Bill and John Henry, are no more mythical.

The end result is that a fat person surrounded by fats essentially has to distance themselves from and maybe even abandon a social circle of former friends and maybe family to be successful in weight loss. And the size of these social circles only grows with the obesity epidemic, even as the pool of prospective fit alternative friends shrinks. Additionally, many fits are frankly too fit to really hang out with a recovering fat until they're done recovering. It's like deciding not to be Amish, or something.

By dosing a fat with facts and reality, you undermine the delusions that are the lynchpin of its protection against the dissonance it feels about its disgusting body and its failure to really address the problem. The fat blows up. Other fats who see it emphasize and feel their own dissonance threatened and they blow up. They mobilize. They reee on social media. They comfort each other's bruised reeee-fees online, and assuage their fee-fees with more disordered eating. Every unsuccessful challenge to their world view pushes them further into obesity and raises the stakes riding on their delusion.

Fat people see the keystone of their worldview at risk when they're confronted with facts. Meanwhile, you have almost nothing to gain by berating a fat. They're pitiful.
